objective: Fix the reviewed foundation, staged-candidate validation and knowledge-query defects before the first product refactor slice
authorization: update affected task routing and tool documentation
out_of_scope: product implementation or complete product capability audit
persistent agent runtime or automatic learning
acceptance: Missing required skills or roles, malformed task contracts and model/reasoning drift fail foundation checks
Task routing identifies at most one active contract and retains completed bootstrap as history
Precommit verifies the staged candidate in isolation without altering the original index or working tree; missing staged dependencies and index changes fail
Knowledge search needs no persistent index, returns current authoritative facts and reports expired/inactive source drift without blocking unrelated valid facts
Active source drift, private source access, unsafe paths and concurrent knowledge changes remain rejected
Regression tests, integrated make check and scoped candidate review pass with explicit evidence boundaries
